description: Paraphrased questions that share few or no words with the target excerpt, plus unrelated questions that should return nothing. Written after the semantic threshold was fixed and not used to choose it.

relevant.question: What did management say about deliveries running late?
Was a long-term customer agreement extended?
Did the business generate more cash from operations?
Is spending on capital projects changing?

unrelated.question: What will the dividend yield be in 2030?
